content.title: Isolate flaky shared-state backend e2e test

content.content:
Verified complete. Both worker children are done:
- Isolate (mqe0745gy7): done — applied playwright.config.ts serialization (workers:1 + fullyParallel:false).
- Validate (mqe074zvth): done — webapp-validator confirmed all 3 criteria PASS:
  1. Previously-flaky tests deterministic: 30+ executions of both target tests, zero failures.
  2. No regressions: 6 full-suite runs (152 tests), the only failure was a known unrelated frontend timing bug (mqe1drwrck).
  3. Isolation does not mask real failures: verified via code review (pure scheduling change, no retries/skips/mocks) + a bug-injection probe that correctly tripped the assertion + negative-path tests still asserting.

Fix is correct, deterministic, and safe. Marking Deliverable C done.

Note (non-blocking): validator observed a transient bunx ESM-loader hiccup during runs that resolved by switching to npx. Flagged for awareness; not tracked here.
